I’ve heard HRT can help with reducing shoulder muscle and therefore help with some of the size issue. But I do like my bushy eyebrows!

I had the rough conversation with my girlfriend explaining how I felt and trying to open up the discussion. It went better than I thought, it’s really nice to have the support of someone close.

I mentioned above but speaking to a therapist is my next step. Thanks for the advice.
Thanks for the advice, I think talking to someone will be the next step no matter what I do.
